topics.label: Course introduction and learning objectives
topics.groupedBecause: The lecturer introduces the final lecture of the course and outlines its learning objectives.

topics.label: Surgery, radiotherapy, and cytotoxic chemotherapy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine traditional modalities of cancer treatment and the systemic toxicities and resistance mechanisms associated with cytotoxic drugs.

topics.label: Exploiting intrinsic cancer cell vulnerabilities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss therapeutic strategies that exploit cancer-specific biological weaknesses such as hormone dependence, cell cycle checkpoint defects, and DNA repair deficiencies.

topics.label: Oncogene addiction and kinase inhibitor resistance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe small-molecule inhibitors targeting hyperactivated oncogenic kinases and the molecular mechanisms that lead to treatment resistance and bypass.

topics.label: Monoclonal antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how engineered antibodies and antibody-drug conjugates are used to target cancer cell surface antigens.

topics.label: Immunotherapy and cellular therapies
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how the immune system interacts with tumors and can be harnessed therapeutically through checkpoint blockade, bispecific engagers, and engineered T cells.

topics.label: Challenges, historical progress, and future directions
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate overall treatment progress, ongoing clinical challenges, and future perspectives in cancer management.
